m.e: Could give clues to who did this.

m.t: Eres un detective que no encuentra pistas.
m.e: You're a detective who doesn't find clues.

m.t: Teníamos pistas de kilos, pero este tipo traficaba en toneladas.
m.e: And we were tracking kilos, but this guy dealt in metric tons.

m.t: ¿Esto puede detenernos de buscar las pistas?
m.e: Can you stop us from looking for the clues'?

m.t: En este momento, no hay pistas.
m.e: At this time, there are no leads.

m.t: - Tenemos un montón de buenas pistas.
m.e: - We have a lot of good clues.

m.t: Voy a darte dos pistas.
m.e: I'm going to give you two hints.

m.t: Creí que no teníamos pistas.
m.e: I thought we didn't have any leads.

m.t: ¿Aún no hay más pistas?
m.e: No other leads yet?

m.e: When Tom speaks English, you can detect traces of all the different places he's lived in.

m.e: He's still covering his kid's tracks.

m.t: Escuché un par de pistas en la oficina de Bart.
m.e: Heard a couple of your tracks over there at Bart's office.

m.t: Veo una caja de pistas.
m.e: I see a clue box.

m.t: Buscaba a mi siguiente blanco en el juego.
m.e: I was looking for my next target in the game.

m.t: No pude encontrar nada de lo que buscaba.
m.e: I couldn't find anything I was looking for.

m.t: Yo no buscaba ponerme serio con nadie, en realidad.
m.e: I wasn't looking to get serious with anybody, really.

m.e: There's the rousing vote of confidence I was looking for.

m.e: I know now why Reiter sought this power.
